name: Charges
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

ChargeType.name: Charge Type
ChargeType.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

CalculationBasis.name: Calculation Basis
CalculationBasis.definition: Calculation basis for the charge or fee.

BearerType.name: Bearer Type
BearerType.definition: Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a charge is a credit or a debit.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Maximum amount of money asked or paid for the charge for example depending on the type of investors.

BaseAmount.name: Base Amount
BaseAmount.definition: Amount on which the charges are calculated.

MaximumRate.name: Maximum Rate
MaximumRate.definition: Maximum rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee for example depending on the type of investors.

MinimumRate.name: Minimum Rate
MinimumRate.definition: Minimum rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee for example depending on the type of investors.

MinimumAmount.name: Minimum Amount
MinimumAmount.definition: Minimum amount of money asked or paid for the charge for example depending on the type of investors.

ChargesDebitAccount.name: Charges Debit Account
ChargesDebitAccount.definition: Account from which a charge is debited.

InvestmentFundTransaction.name: Investment Fund Transaction
InvestmentFundTransaction.definition: Investment fund transaction for which charges are specified.

LogisticsChargeLineItem.name: Logistics Charge Line Item
LogisticsChargeLineItem.definition: Specifies the line item to which the logistics charge applies.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.definition: Specifies the transport process to which the charges apply.

Services.name: Services
Services.definition: Account services for which account administration charges are specified.

RelatedUndertaking.name: Related Undertaking
RelatedUndertaking.definition: Undertaking for which charges are specified.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Line item for which charges are specified

NetPriceChargeLineItem.name: Net Price Charge Line Item
NetPriceChargeLineItem.definition: Specifies the line item to which the net price charge applies.

RelatedInterest.name: Related Interest
RelatedInterest.definition: Interest on which charges are applied.
